results.title: Kodal Minerals eyes lithium expansion across West Africa | Semafor
results.snippet:
Kodal Minerals plans to expand its lithium business across West Africa, betting the gold-rich region can become a major supplier of the battery metal, Reuters reported.

The London-listed miner began producing lithium last year in Mali, in a joint venture with Chinese mining company Hainan Mining. Kodal has now agreed to acquire up to 80% of the Asamankese lithium exploration project in Ghana. [..
